title: Worker boundary exempts runners.toml but not runners.local/cloud.toml
body:
exemptFromBoundary lets a worker amend .tick/runners.toml (the runner table) but not its substrate overrides, .tick/runners.local.toml and .tick/runners.cloud.toml, which are the same table. A tick whose deliverable is a change to cloud or local routing therefore cannot be delivered by a worker: tda attempt 2 was refused whole for writing runners.cloud.toml. The exemption list, the prompt line built from it, and contracts/lifecycle-invariants.json if it mirrors the list, should name the whole runners-file family.
evidence: internal/exec/subprocess/report.go:190 exemptFromBoundary; tda attempt 2 result.json boundary_violations [.tick/runners.cloud.toml]
